record.body:
## Rationale

`~/.canon/<repo-name>/canon.db` reuses the existing `global` store location and binding. Every worktree of the repo resolves to the same file, so parallel phases in `.worktrees/` share one store and no worktree holds a stale copy.

## Counter-argument

A gitignored `<primary checkout>/.canon/canon.db` is easier to find and cannot collide with another project of the same name. It forces each worktree to carry a binding override to reach the primary checkout, which is the stale-store problem in a new form.
